description: Cameroun - Situations des Inondations is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by OCHA Cameroon. Ce jeu de données porte sur les inondations au Cameroun et leurs impacts sur la population. Coverage: Cameroon. The portal files it under the publisher OCHA Cameroon. Its tags are affected population, climate-weather, flooding, hxl. It offers 3 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2025-11-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
